items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I played with Tony Amarica on the boat during the war too. Boy we had a heck of a band. Very good band. Lester Bouchon, Shorty Reese, Fazola and myself on saxophones.

ctx.x: Yeah, I might have heard you when I was in the Navy and didn't know you then. I remember talking to Charlie Duke out there. I think it was his wife or his girlfriend who introduced me to him. At the time I was still interested in, very interested in the band.

I played with Tony Amarica on the boat during the war too. Boy we had a heck of a band. Very good band. Lester Bouchon, Shorty Reese, Fazola and myself on saxophones. I played alto on that job too. I played lead and Fazola played third alto and Bouchon and Shorty Reese played the tenors. And Bobby Castleglough played trombone. And Red Bowman played trumpet and Howard Reed on trumpet. Alec Coulon on bass, Joe Salvaggio on piano, and Abbey Brunish, the one that died, played drums.
